title: Drop forced full-context last layer under WINDOW_PATTERN=SSSS
description: Removed the `window_sizes[-1] = (long_window, 0)` override in _compute_window_sizes so every layer (including the last) uses the short (half-context) window when WINDOW_PATTERN=SSSS, instead of forcing one full-context layer; avoided duplicating a0/a2's identical DEPTH=10-under-SSSS proposal.
reflection: val_bpb 0.998511 vs 0.998440 baseline — essentially a wash, within the noise band seen for nominally-identical reruns elsewhere in the log (~0.00005-0.0002). The one forced full-context layer isn't hurting, but removing it isn't a win either; not worth keeping over the simpler baseline unless a repeat confirms a real direction. This closes out the 'is the forced long-window layer necessary' question a1 raised: the answer is roughly 'doesn't matter much either way,' so don't spend more slots on it.
